about: The tractus of the formulary “Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: So now, O children, listen to me; happy those who keep my ways. Hear instruction, and be wise, and refuse it not. Happy the man who obeys me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my doorposts. For he who finds me finds life, and wins favor from the Lord.
